## Summary

Describe the change. Link the tracked issue through the pull request's **Development** field; do not add a `Closes #...` line to this description.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactoring or maintenance
- [ ] Breaking change (include migration guidance)

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. Use the checks relevant to the change:

- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test` (unit and Firebase Emulator integration tests)
- [ ] `npm run test:coverage`
- [ ] `npm run docs:build` (when documentation changes)

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior where applicable.
- [ ] User-facing documentation is updated where applicable.
- [ ] Commits use `#<issue number>: <imperative title>` and explain what changed and why.
- [ ] The related issue is linked in the pull request's **Development** field.
